caseNameFull: Wyman, Commissioner of Social Services of New York v. Rothstein
attorneys: Louis J. Lefkowitz, Attorney General of New York, Samuel A. Hirshowitz, First Assistant Attorney General, Amy Juviler, Assistant Attorney General, and Philip Weinberg for appellants. Carl Rachlin for ap-pellees.

opinions.text: Appeal from D. C. S. D. N. Y. Motion of appellees for leave to proceed in forma pauperis granted. Probable jurisdiction noted.
